item.title: Make HomePod Alert You to Smoke Alarms
item.description: Thanks to Apple's Sound Recognition feature, the HomePod mini and second-generation HomePod can send you notifications when they recognize smoke or carbon monoxide alarm sounds. Keep reading to learn how it works. With Sound Recognition, HomePod can detect the sound of a smoke or carbon monoxide alarm in your home, and alert you by sending a notification to your iPhone, iPad or Apple Watch. item.title: Apple is Getting Rid of iTunes Wish Lists, Here's How to Save Yours
item.description: Apple will soon do away with iTunes Wish Lists featuring movie and TV shows, according to emails going out to customers as of today. item.title: Why You Shouldn't Buy the Next MacBook Pro
item.description: Apple is planning to launch new MacBook Pro models as soon as early March, but if you can, this is one generation you should skip because there's something much better in the works.
